headline: Sensex and Nifty eye volatile start amid strong Q2 earnings and negative GIFT Nifty signals

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: GIFT Nifty signals a negative start for the Indian markets despite positive Asian cues
Strong Q2 financial results from Mankind Pharma and Tata Consumer provide fundamental support
Markets snapped a four-session losing streak on Monday due to value buying
Expected volatility in the market ahead of the monthly expiry
whatHappening: SFC Environmental Technologies IPO opens today with a grey market premium of 9%
Mankind Pharma reported a 38% rise in Q2 profit to Rs 716 crore
Crude oil prices remain below $115 as peace talk hopes balance supply worries
Kotak Mahindra and Sun Pharma emerged as top gainers in the previous trading session
summary: Indian markets are expected to open with volatility as GIFT Nifty suggests a negative start despite a recovery in the previous session. Investors are focusing on strong Q2 earnings from Mankind Pharma and Tata Consumer, alongside the launch of the SFC Environmental Technologies IPO. Global factors, including fluctuating oil prices and Middle East diplomacy, continue to influence sentiment.
